newDescription:
In this Year 3 Maths lesson, pupils develop advanced measurement skills across length, mass, volume and capacity, perimeter, money and time.

This lesson includes:
✔ Measuring and comparing lengths using millimetres, centimetres and metres
✔ Converting between metres, centimetres and millimetres
✔ Comparing mixed length measurements by converting to a common unit
✔ Solving word problems involving length and difference
✔ Measuring and comparing mass using grams and kilograms
✔ Converting between grams and kilograms, including decimal and mixed-unit forms
✔ Comparing masses and solving practical mass problems
✔ Converting between litres and millilitres
✔ Comparing capacity and volume and solving related word problems
✔ Calculating perimeter for equilateral triangles, squares and rectangles
✔ Adding amounts of money and calculating change
✔ Reading analogue clocks and converting between 12-hour and 24-hour time
✔ Converting between seconds, minutes and hours
✔ Comparing durations and estimating time
✔ Revising the number of days in each month and leap years
✔ Solving duration and journey-time problems

Pupils begin with length, measuring real objects and comparing measurements before converting between millimetres, centimetres and metres. They then apply these conversions to mixed-unit comparisons and word problems.

The lesson continues with mass, volume and capacity. Pupils convert between grams and kilograms and between millilitres and litres, compare quantities expressed in different units, and solve practical problems involving everyday contexts.

Later sections develop perimeter, money and time. Pupils calculate the perimeter of common shapes, total prices and change, read analogue clocks, convert between 12-hour and 24-hour time, and work with seconds, minutes and hours.

The final activities cover calendar knowledge, leap years and multi-step duration problems, including calculating journey times and finding end times.

By the end of the lesson, learners will be able to choose appropriate units, convert and compare measurements accurately, and solve a wide range of practical measurement and time problems.
